posts.title: Diesel Prices and Inflation
posts.description: As everyone knows, the USA is drastically affecting just about everything with regards to the global economy. Inflation and with it the "normal" response from the Bank of Canada will be to raise interest rates. However, I don't think that is the right thing to do, because the way that raising the base interest rate affects inflation is to "reduces demand for goods and services".
